thread:
sanjay: Observed regressions this morning after the kernel selector change + batcher tweak. p99 up ~180ms on long-seqs, KV hit ratio dipped from 72% -> 58% for batch-stitched flows. Looks like prefetch gap is causing more KV misses during assembly. cc @molly

molly: Ugh. can you paste the profile/logs? :thinking:

sanjay: Paste: 
```
2026-03-18T09:12:03Z kernel-selector: switched to wave-optimizations
2026-03-18T09:12:05Z batcher: enabled stitch-window=15ms
metrics: p50=23ms p95=112ms p99=298ms
after: p50=25ms p95=140ms p99=470ms
kv: hit=72.1% -> 58.4%
req-types: long-seq ratio up 9%
```

molly: stitch-window 15ms seems too aggressive for our prefetch pattern. Could be causing late arrivals to miss cached prefixes -> KV refill penalty. maybe lower window or make it adaptive by seq-length lane.

eva: Also check kernel hint mispredictions: if kernel chosen assumes shorter context then KV cached layout mismatches -> extra memcpy and kernel fallback slows p99.

tom: Agree. We should try a two-pronged approach: 1) introduce 'credit lanes' so requests declare expected token-burn and join small/large lanes; 2) change admission to soft-credit that returns 429-like soft-shed but with Retry-After and credit refund policy.

sanjay: Proposal: token budget targets per lane: small-lane=32 tokens, med=128, long=512. Batcher will only stitch if deadline - enqueue_time > min_stitch_for_lane. min_stitch_small=8ms, med=12ms, long=25ms. Admission: if queue token budget depleted for lane -> return soft 429 with header `X-Redwood-Soft-Shed: lane=<name>`.

molly: That sounds sensible. For KV prefetch, add a prefetch-gap heuristic: track avg inter-arrival for a user/session prefix; if inter-arrival < gap_thresh we prefetch; otherwise skip prefetch to avoid cache thrash. gap_thresh per model is ~20ms default.

eva: Can we also instrument 'kernel scorecard' in tracing so we know when chosen kernel had >10% time over baseline. Add sampling 1% of requests with full CPU/GPU timelines.

perf-bot: perf-regression-alert: created issue RI-1284. linked traces: https://perf.internal/trace/RI-1284

tom: Experiment plan: AB test across 3 hosts: control (current), A (credit lanes + lower stitch windows), B (credit lanes + adaptive prefetch + kernel rollback on mismatch). Collect p99, kv-hit, throughput for 48h.

sanjay: Action items:
- @molly: implement credit lanes + stitch-window config (PR by EOD Thu)
- @eva: kernel scorecard instrumentation + trace sampling (PR by Mon)
- @tom: run AB infra + traffic split (setup by Fri)
- @sanjay: add perf dashboards and blocklist for models that regress (dashboard + RI-1284)

molly: quick Q: for soft-429 semantics do we charge tokens? I'd prefer to not charge and refund any reserved credit.

sanjay: agreed — soft-429 -> refund reserved tokens, set `Retry-After` 50ms * (1 + lane_factor).

eva: Also add a small circuit-breaker: if kv-hit drop > 15% in 1m window, automatically reduce stitch-window by 50% for affected hosts.

tom: ok I'll add the deploy playbook for rollback if p99 increases > 20% in AB A/B.

molly: sounds good. I'll start the PR and include benchmarks.

sanjay: thanks all. We'll sync in 24h on early signals. :thumbsup:
